author: rmgoshawa
title: Artist wanted for collaborative neighbourhood banner
content: Exciting news! Are you a community focused and engaged creative? We have an amazing opportunity for an artist or artist group to design a collaborative banner for The Robert McLaughlin Gallery and LivingRoom Community Art Studio's Neighbourhood Project. The selected design will be featured on a series of banners on an exterior wall of the RMG and on flags/banners for the LRCAS Mobile Art Hive Bus throughout the year. Design Proposal Submission Deadline: October 9th, 2026, 5PM. Artist(s) Selection Date: October 21, 2026. Artist(s) Fee/Commission: $2,500. Please visit the link in our bio or rmg.on.ca/opportunities for submission details.
